items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "You got Joe over there. You got Sam over. Enough drummers."

ctx.x: Saddle bags. The bag with the mail.

That’s the same idea what they had in the brass band. And they would swing out. They got a big joy after that one or two hours of solemn sadness, screaming and hollaring, “Joe’s gone. We ain’t gonna see him no more,” and all that business. Here’s a refreshing thing. Everybody got a smile on their face. It was nice to see that Sam Brown died in the bed. He didn’t die in a wreck or die in the ocean. He wasn’t drowned. The casket was open. You could see him, how he was well cared of until he died. That’s a highly…
Let me ask you this: did they have jazz funerals for whites when you were coming up?
